name: Tue Kjærgaard Nielsen
role: Tenure Track Assistant Professor / Group Leader
bio:
Tue Kjærgaard Nielsen is a Tenure Track Assistant Professor in the Section for Microbial Ecology and Biotechnology at the Department of Plant and Environmental Sciences, University of Copenhagen. He is a molecular microbiologist specialising in microbial evolution and the role of mobile genetic elements.

### Research Focus
- PFAS Biodegradation: investigating microbial pathways for the degradation of PFAS and fluoride toxicity.
- Genomics & Bioinformatics: utilising 3rd generation (Nanopore) and Illumina sequencing for genetic context analysis and antibiotic resistance gene prediction.
- Mobile Genetic Elements: studying the impact of MGEs, plasmids, and bacteriophages on microbial evolution, including detection of nucleotide modifications.

### Background
Tue earned his PhD in Environmental Science from Aarhus University (2017) and has extensive experience in bioinformatic analysis of exotic DNA modifications and microbial ecology.
